document: Gate 3-B.4 task 4 - FROZEN reasoning-error codebook for the 7 GPT T3D-Strict unsupported-ACCEPT cells

scope.units: the 7 GPT-4.1-mini T3D-Strict cells whose final verdict is ACCEPT under a condition gold of NEED_EVIDENCE (issues 13615, 13974, 15349, 17318, 17630, 21847, 24443)
scope.excluded_units: the 3 correct NEED_EVIDENCE cells (19783, 20590, 24213) are NOT coded here; this codebook characterises committed-acceptance reasoning only
scope.input_to_coder: the model free-text final reasoning plus the generic sequence of tool names it called. The coder never receives: issue number, model name, oracle/condition gold, any historical verdict, or any prior classification tag.

blinding_protocol.id_removal: each cell receives a random ID D01-D07 using G3B4_BLIND_SEED=417997; the mapping to issue numbers is written to a SEPARATE sealed file and only joined after coding is persisted
blinding_protocol.text_masking: in the reasoning text, issue/PR numbers, all test_* identifiers, file paths and numeric literals are replaced with placeholders (<ISSUE>, <TESTk>, <PATH>, <NUM>) before coding
blinding_protocol.residual_unblinding_risk: PARTIAL blind only: natural-language symptom descriptions and API names that uniquely identify a SymPy issue may remain, so re-identification by a domain expert cannot be ruled out

C1_SYMPTOM_RESOLUTION_AS_ACCEPTANCE.definition: The reasoning treats disappearance/non-reproduction of the reported symptom (the issue no longer reproduces, output is now correct on the reported case) as sufficient grounds that the patch is acceptable/mergeable, without a maintainer acceptance or regression verdict.
include_signals: states the symptom/issue no longer reproduces or is fixed
concludes acceptance because the reported case now behaves correctly
uses the consistency tool's symptom verdict as the acceptance basis
C1_SYMPTOM_RESOLUTION_AS_ACCEPTANCE.exclude: merely mentioning that the symptom is gone while explicitly deferring acceptance to withheld test outcomes (that is C4 or correct withholding)

C2_COVERAGE_COMPLETENESS_AS_VERDICT.definition: The reasoning converts coverage STRUCTURE (declared tests all executed, no missing ids, coverage complete, tests fully run) into a pass/acceptance verdict, conflating 'every declared test ran' with 'the declared acceptance/regression outcomes are satisfactory'.
include_signals: all tests executed/fully covered/complete therefore acceptable
no missing tests therefore the patch is correct
treats declared==executed counts as evidence of success
C2_COVERAGE_COMPLETENESS_AS_VERDICT.exclude: reporting coverage completeness as a neutral fact without using it to justify the ACCEPT

C3_ABSENCE_OF_FAILURE_EVIDENCE_AS_EVIDEN.definition: The reasoning argues 'there is no evidence of any failure/regression/failing acceptance test' and treats that absence as affirmative evidence that no failure exists and the patch is acceptable — despite acceptance outcomes being withheld.
include_signals: no evidence of (any) failure/regression/failing acceptance check
no new failures / no failures observed therefore acceptable
acceptable for merge / is acceptable / patch correctly ... grounded only in absence of observed failure
C3_ABSENCE_OF_FAILURE_EVIDENCE_AS_EVIDEN.exclude: a genuinely observed passing acceptance verdict (unavailable under strict)

C4_WITHHOLDING_ACKNOWLEDGED_BUT_OVERRIDD.definition: The reasoning explicitly acknowledges that maintainer acceptance outcomes are withheld/not adjudicated under the strict policy, yet still returns a decisive ACCEPT instead of abstaining — the withholding is noticed but not treated as decisive.
include_signals: notes outcomes are not provided/withheld/beyond scope, then accepts anyway
explicitly says acceptance is not adjudicated but still commits
C4_WITHHOLDING_ACKNOWLEDGED_BUT_OVERRIDD.exclude: acknowledging withholding and consequently returning NEED_EVIDENCE (correct abstention, out of scope)

C5_PROVENANCE_FRESHNESS_AS_SUBSTANCE.definition: The reasoning uses provenance/integrity facts (authentic signature, linkage verified, fresh restage, evidence current) as if they were substantive evidence the patch is correct, rather than merely that the evidence is trustworthy.
include_signals: freshness or signature used as a reason to accept
C5_PROVENANCE_FRESHNESS_AS_SUBSTANCE.exclude: using provenance only to establish the evidence is usable, with acceptance justified elsewhere

C6_OTHER.definition: Committed-acceptance reasoning under a NEED gold that does not match C1-C5; requires a free-text rationale and is reviewed individually.
C6_OTHER.exclude: use only when none of C1-C5 apply

assignment_rules.multi_label: apply EVERY code whose definition is satisfied; a unit can carry several codes
assignment_rules.primary_code: the single code that licenses the final ACCEPT in the explicit conclusion clause (the clause introduced by therefore/thus/so/hence/conclude/acceptable). If several appear in that clause, choose the code whose evidence is the MOST proximal to the acceptability claim, in the priority C3 > C1 > C2 > C5 > C4; C6 only if none of C1-C5 fires
assignment_rules.confidence: high if the conclusion clause contains the defining signal verbatim; medium if it relies on an adjacent sentence; low if inferred
assignment_rules.no_forced_fit: if the text does not satisfy C1-C5, use C6 rather than forcing a code

coder_and_independence_disclosure.coder: the SAME AI assistant that authored the g3b4 audit pipeline; coding is implemented as deterministic, codebook-derived rules
coder_and_independence_disclosure.not_independent_arbitration: this coding is an internal reproducible characterisation and MUST NOT be represented as independent human adjudication; a genuine second-annotator plan is delivered separately in the Gate 3-B.4 report (task 11)
coder_and_independence_disclosure.safeguard_against_drift: the codebook above is frozen (its sha256 is recorded) BEFORE the blinded packets are coded, the coder sees only masked text, and the rule-to-code mapping was fixed in this same file before any packet was opened
